name: Nagykutas (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of three stripes, blue, white and blue, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Nagykutas (a blue shield with a white figure holding a sword) above a yellow scroll inscribed NAGYKUTAS.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
